name: Nephron epithelium
failures: Progressive fibrosis, tubular injury, glomerular loss. Nephrons are never rebuilt after birth.

see.note: eGFR reports whole-organ function; biopsy is invasive and focal.

model.note: Nephron architecture is a 3-D pattern cells do not re-derive.

reach.note: Filtration means most agents pass through rather than into tubular cells.

edit.note: No approved therapy repairs or replaces nephron cells. Dialysis substitutes function.

verify.note: eGFR and proteinuria are reliable functional measures.

anchors: Nephron endowment is fixed at birth in humans
